Key Rental Rules

  • Rental Window: 22 hours
  • Grace Period: 2 hours (return process must be initiated within this period)
  • Late Fee: ₱50 per hour (or part of an hour)

1. Acceptance of Terms

By creating a reservation through the CREATY system, you ("Customer") enter into a legally binding agreement with Nifty Fifty Camera Rentals and agree to all terms and conditions listed below.

2. Definitions

  • Equipment: Camera gear and related items listed for rental.
  • Reservation: A booking request submitted through CREATY that becomes valid only after confirmation by Nifty Fifty staff.
  • Rental Period: The 22-hour usage period starting from the time the equipment is received by the Customer.
  • Grace Period: A 2-hour period provided for the Customer to initiate the return process after the rental period ends.
  • Late Period: The period after the Grace Period until the equipment is successfully returned and verified.

3. Reservation and Equipment Assignment

  • Reservations submitted through CREATY are considered requests until confirmed by Nifty Fifty staff.
  • Equipment assignment is automatically managed by CREATY based on equipment availability, event requirements, and fair usage rotation.
  • Customers must provide accurate reservation details, including event information and contact details.
  • Reservation cancellations must be made through official communication channels.
  • Nifty Fifty reserves the right to modify or reject reservations due to equipment availability, inaccurate information, or policy violations.

4. Claiming Equipment

Customers must select one claiming method:

Pick-up

  • Customer must collect the equipment at Nifty Fifty's designated location during business hours.
  • Customer must present a valid identification document when claiming equipment.
  • Equipment condition will be checked before release.

Meet-up

  • Meet-up schedule, location, and time must be confirmed by Nifty Fifty staff.
  • Customer must arrive on time.
  • Failure to appear or excessive delays may result in cancellation of the reservation.

Delivery

  • Customer may request delivery of equipment through available delivery options.
  • Customer is responsible for arranging and coordinating the delivery service.
  • All delivery, courier, shipping, and transportation fees shall be fully shouldered by the Customer as an additional fee separate from the rental fee.
  • Delivery charges are not included in the equipment rental price unless specifically stated.
  • Nifty Fifty is not responsible for delays, damages, losses, or issues caused by third-party courier or delivery services.
  • Customer must provide valid identity verification requirements when requested before equipment release.

5. Returning Equipment, Grace Period, and Penalties

Customers must select one return method:

Return to Store

  • Customer must return equipment to Nifty Fifty's designated location within the agreed return schedule.

Meet-up Return

  • Return schedule, location, and time must be arranged and confirmed with Nifty Fifty staff.
  • Customer must ensure the equipment is available for inspection upon return.

Delivery Return

  • Customer may arrange a courier or delivery service to return the equipment.
  • All return delivery, courier, shipping, and transportation fees shall be fully shouldered by the Customer as an additional fee separate from the rental fee.
  • Customer is responsible for ensuring that the equipment is properly packed and safely transported.
  • Nifty Fifty is not responsible for delays, losses, or damages caused during third-party transportation.

Late Return Rules

  • The 2-hour Grace Period is provided only for initiating the return process and is not an extension of equipment usage.
  • Returns completed after the Grace Period will incur a ₱50 per hour late fee (or part of an hour).
  • Failure to return equipment within 24 hours after the Grace Period may be considered unauthorized retention, and Nifty Fifty may pursue appropriate legal action.

6. Care, Liability, and Fees

  • Customer is responsible for the equipment from the time of receipt until the equipment has been inspected and officially accepted by Nifty Fifty.
  • Customer shall be liable for any damage, loss, missing accessories, or theft involving rented equipment.
  • Repair, replacement, and recovery costs shall be charged to the responsible Customer.
  • All rental fees, delivery fees, late penalties, damages, and other applicable charges remain the Customer's responsibility.
  • Nifty Fifty is not responsible for indirect damages, including missed events, missed opportunities, lost files, or business losses.

7. Refund Policy

  • Customers may request cancellation of a reservation through official channels.
  • Refund requests will be reviewed and approved based on the reservation status and applicable circumstances.
  • Approved cancellations made before equipment release may be eligible for a refund.
  • Once equipment has been claimed or the rental period has started, rental fees are generally non-refundable.
  • Delivery fees, courier charges, and other third-party service fees are non-refundable once processed.
  • Refunds will not be issued for cancellations caused by Customer negligence, failure to comply with requirements, late arrival, misuse of equipment, or violation of these Terms and Conditions.
  • Any outstanding charges, including late fees, damages, missing equipment costs, or other penalties, may be deducted from the refundable amount.
  • Approved refunds will be processed within 7–14 business days, depending on the payment provider or financial institution.
  • Nifty Fifty reserves the right to deny refund requests involving fraud, misuse of CREATY, false information, or violations of rental policies.

8. Account Integrity, Privacy, and General Provisions

  • Customers must provide accurate and complete information when creating an account and making reservations.
  • Misuse of CREATY, including fraudulent reservations or false information, may result in account suspension or termination.
  • Customer identification documents are collected only for verification purposes and handled according to the Privacy Policy.
  • Nifty Fifty's maximum liability is limited to the total rental or package amount paid for the reservation.
  • Nifty Fifty reserves the right to update these Terms and Conditions at any time.
  • Continued use of CREATY after updates means acceptance of the revised Terms and Conditions.
